en: Section on Cultivation (Bhāvanāvāra) He who cultivates a wholesome state (kusala-dhamma) abandons an unwholesome state (akusala-dhamma)? Yes.
Or again, is it the case that whoever abandons an unwholesome state develops a wholesome state? Yes.
Is it the case that whoever does not develop a wholesome state does not abandon an unwholesome state? Yes.
Or again, is it the case that whoever does not abandon an unwholesome state does not develop a wholesome state? Yes … [and so on] …
The Text of the Dhamma-Yamaka is finished.
